comparison.objective: Locate a hidden wall fastener using a magnetic stud finder.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain flat sliding contact against a wall until magnetic capture occurs, then release the finder.
comparison.success_condition: Finder locks to the hidden screw and hangs stably after release.
comparison.reason: Its sliding is exploratory surface scanning ending in magnetic capture; it lacks end-face bridging, transfer between supports, and freely escaping rolling elements. No missing rubric detail prevents distinction.
